text: Shared control vocabulary for S1-TRU-01 and -02 (use ids exactly): CC-1 permission modes and rules; CC-2 managed settings; CC-3 sandboxing; CC-4 hooks; CC-5 MCP allowlisting; CC-6 OpenTelemetry audit export; CC-7 Bedrock/Vertex provider path; CC-8 auth, SSO, credentials incl. headless CI; CC-9 data-handling settings.
